What it means: The Boston Zoning Commission held public hearings on text amendment application 557 and map amendment application 801 for the South Boston neighborhood district [03:26], text amendment applications 554 through 556 updating citywide dimensional definitions [11:38, 23:34], and text amendment application 558 with map amendment application 802 for Cleary Square in Hyde Park [27:49, 52:34]. The commission approved the South Boston measure to allow Planned Development Areas in the Waterfront Manufacturing subdistrict [05:44, 11:12], passed the citywide dimensional definitions code consolidation [15:37, 24:02], and adopted the Cleary Square rezoning under the Squares and Streets initiative [29:53, 53:12]. All three proposals received unanimous yes votes from attending commission members [11:12, 24:02, 53:12].

Who moved it: The planning department presented all three proposals, represented by planners Michelle Lee for South Boston [04:56] and Maya Caller Gold for the dimensional definitions and Cleary Square items [13:08, 29:10]. An unnamed commissioner made the motion to approve the South Boston proposal [10:32], Commissioner Maher moved to approve the citywide dimensional definitions proposal [23:32], and an unnamed commissioner moved to approve the Cleary Square proposal [52:29]. The transcript does not name the specific commissioner who made the first or third motions beyond their unstated voice on the recording [10:32, 52:29].

What to watch: Following the South Boston vote, planning department staff will return to the commission at a later date to present the specific contents of the Reserve Channel development proposal once its community process concludes [07:00]. Commission staff member Jeffrey announced that the next meeting is scheduled for December 9th [53:24], which will cover a proposed freeze on linkage rates, a payment schedule amendment to Article 80 [53:33, 53:41], and a minor amendment regarding facade telecommunications equipment at the East Boston Hotel [54:01].

summary: The Boston Zoning Commission held a public hearing [02:25] to consider three zoning proposals. Planning department staff presented text amendment application 557 and map amendment 4F to update Article 68, allowing Planned Development Areas within the Waterfront Manufacturing subdistrict in South Boston [03:29]-[06:31], which the commission approved by roll call vote [10:33]-[11:10]. Staff then presented text amendment applications 550 through 556 to update, clarify, and consolidate code language for dimensional definitions [11:38]-[15:41], and the commission voted to approve those amendments [23:32]-[24:02]. Finally, staff and District 5 Councilor Pepén presented text amendment application 558 and map amendment application 757 to establish Squares and Streets zoning in Cleary Square within the Hyde Park Neighborhood District [27:47]-[28:02], [42:06]-[42:21], which the commission approved following public testimony and board discussion [44:14]-[46:15], [52:37]-[53:12].
